articleTitle: Ultrastructural insights into cellular organization, energy storage and ribosomal dynamics of an ammonia-oxidizing archaeon from oligotrophic oceans
author: Yangkai Zhou, An Yan, Jiawen Yang, Wei He, Shuai Guo, Yifan Li, Jing Wu, Yanchao Dai, Xijiang Pan, Dongyu Cui, Olivier Pereira, Wenkai Teng, Ran Bi, Songze Chen, Lu Fan, Peiyi Wang, Yan Liao, Wei Qin, Sen-Fang Sui, Yuanqing Zhu, Chuanlun Zhang, Zheng Liu
sourceCaption: Figure 1. Whole-cell cryo-electron tomogram of Nitrosopumilus maritimus SCM1. A-C are cryo-EM images at -60, 0, and +60 degrees; D is a tomographic slice; E is a 3D segmentation. The selected panel is B (0 degrees), preserving its visible 200 nm scale bar.
changes: Extracted only actual photographic panel B from the multipart figure
Kept the panel label, tilt angle and 200 nm scale bar
No upscaling, no generative alteration; JPEG re-encoding
